name: Paced breath

cues.text: Breathe in as the shape grows and out as it shrinks.
This pace is a common starting point, not a personal setting. If it feels too slow, breathe at your own pace.
If your mind wanders, come back to the shape.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel dizzy or lightheaded.
Stop if you feel tingling or numbness in your hands or face.
Stop if your chest feels tight.
Stop if your vision changes or blurs.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Slow your breath and notice how it feels.
copy.end: Let your breath return to its own rhythm. Notice how you feel now.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Moderate is for the slow-breathing and HRV association (Laborde 2022, abstract only). Six breaths per minute as a default for mood is weak. The copy makes no HRV or health claim.
